root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the early `hci_dev_unlock(hdev)` (which was at line 3340 before the conditional branches) and moves the unlock to the `unlock:` label at the end, ensuring `hci_connect_cfm(conn, 0)` is called while the lock is held. The CVE description explicitly states: "hci_conn_request_evt() calls hci_connect_cfm(conn) without hdev->lock. Generally hci_connect_cfm() assumes it is held, and if conn is deleted concurrently -> UAF."
